Android grants this listener broad notification access. AI Ready Glyph processes only the apps you select, on your phone. Notification text is never saved or sent. You can revoke access in Android Settings.
Access blocked after installing the APK? Open App info, tap the menu, then Allow restricted settings.
Choose a style to preview or test on your phone.
Looks for phrases such as “response is ready” or “task completed”. English and Polish notifications are supported.
May also react to other alerts from selected apps. Ongoing work, active progress and group summaries are skipped.
e.g. Claude has finished; your result is ready
Enter text from a real ready notification. Separate phrases with semicolons or new lines.
Add AI Ready Glyph to your Toys carousel. Hold the Glyph Button to test the last selected animation. Automatic alerts also work without selecting this Toy.
Open Settings > Glyph Interface > Glyph Toys and add AI Ready Glyph.
